title.en: Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Amount of Edusave Contribution for 2016) Order 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Amount of Edusave Contribution for 2016) Order 2015 and comes into operation on 1 January 2016.
2. For 2016, the qualifying date for every member of the Edusave Pupils Fund (except an individual who becomes in 2016 a member for the first time under section 8(1) of the Act) is 1 January 2016.

3. For 2016, the amount of contribution to be paid under section 9(1)(a) of the Act is —
(a)$200 for each member who is a full‑time student of a prescribed school and receiving primary education at any time during that year; and
(b)$240 for each member who is a full-time student of a prescribed school and receiving secondary education at any time during that year.
